title: Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Pre-Technical Studies; not yet checked by a Pre-Technical Studies teacher; safety lines marked SAFETY in the library to confirm first; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The learner names the five strands of Pre-Technical Studies (Foundations of Pre-Technical Studies, Communication in Pre-Technical Studies, Materials for Production, Tools and Production, Entrepreneurship), places activities in them, and explains how the learning area is used by everyone at home, at work and in business.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the economic activities in the county.
floor.question: Name one economic activity in your county.

representations: photos of Kenyan workers, women and men
steps: Say where each is used in daily life.
Say who uses it: girls, boys, workers, business owners.
contexts: a young woman running a phone repair kiosk

board.do: Draw five columns, one per strand.
Point at the card "make a budget for the club".
board.say: Which strand does this belong to?

board.do: Wait for the learner to say Entrepreneurship.
Sort all the cards into the columns.

listen_for: Only using tools in the workshop
misconceptions.ask: Which of these is part of Pre-Technical Studies?
misconceptions.repair: Show the five strands on a chart and sort ten activities (budgeting, sketching, using a computer, choosing timber, safety rules) into them.

listen_for: Only boys who will become mechanics
misconceptions.repair: Show women engineers, tailors, architects and business owners from Kenya; ask which strand each one uses.

misconceptions.ask: Where is Pre-Technical knowledge used in daily life?
misconceptions.repair: List what a family does in one week (repairing, measuring, budgeting, using a phone safely) and name the strand for each.

misconceptions.ask: Preparing a budget for a school club belongs to which strand of Pre-Technical Studies?
misconceptions.repair: Read the five strand names (Foundations, Communication, Materials for Production, Tools and Production, Entrepreneurship) and place budgeting and computer use in them.

checks.question: Name the strand that deals with tools and making items.
Who uses Pre-Technical knowledge?
checks.answer: Girls and boys, at home and at work
